description: Sample government welfare schemes for Swaraj Saathi demo. This data represents the structure stored in PostgreSQL after web scraping from government portals.

schemes.name: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Direct income support of ₹6,000/year to small and marginal farmer families, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months.

schemes.name: महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजना (MJPJAY)
schemes.name_en: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana
schemes.description: Free medical treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh per family per year at empaneled hospitals in Maharashtra for BPL and APL families.
schemes.benefits: Free treatment up to ₹1,50,000/year covering 1,100+ surgeries

schemes.name: लेक लाडकी योजना
schemes.description: Financial assistance for girl children from economically weaker families in Maharashtra. ₹5,000 at birth to ₹1,01,000 at age 18.

schemes.name: अण्णासाहेब पाटील आर्थिक मागास विकास महामंडळ कर्ज योजना
schemes.name_en: Annasaheb Patil Arthik Magas Vikas Mahamandal Loan Scheme
schemes.description: Interest-free loans up to ₹10 lakh for economically backward youth in Maharashtra to start their own business.
schemes.benefits: Interest subsidy on business loans up to ₹10,00,000

schemes.name: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plains) / ₹1.30 lakh (hilly areas) for construction of pucca house for BPL rural families.
